title: Small Hours of the Sky
statement: I am a baker, so I sleep in the afternoon and wake at three. For twenty years those dark hours have belonged to me and to the Andromeda galaxy.

fragments.title: Two and a half million years
fragments.text: The light I see from Andromeda left before there were humans. I look at it while the dough proves.

fragments.title: A secondhand telescope
fragments.text: Bought from a widow whose husband had written his observations on the tube in pencil. I kept writing in the same column.

fragments.title: Dark adaptation
fragments.text: Thirty minutes without light and your eyes become a different instrument. Patience literally lets you see more.
